user_decision.label: Affected-column remote and path status family

surface.remote_count: beside only the affected full Explorer column label
surface.path_status: directly below the surviving destination column full label and outside its scrolling rows
surface.selected_bit_status: inside the valid current parent column
surface.stale_placement_status: inside the same surviving destination-column strip
surface.single_status: one current fallback strip; later fallback replaces it without history
prohibited: ghost row, column, suffix, or label
VQ-07 Search replacement body or fallback

remote_count_and_anchoring.scope: independent count per currently open visible column
remote_count_and_anchoring.included: ordinary remote insertion first appearing in that visible column after mounted snapshot or last clear
remote_count_and_anchoring.automatic_effect: preserve path, selection, focus, first-visible stable ID, and viewport offset; never restore raw scrollTop, jump, select, or change path
remote_count_and_anchoring.activation: revalidate, scroll only that column to top, clear only its count, and focus the first surviving new row without selection or path change
remote_count_and_anchoring.empty_revalidation: focus the affected full-label heading when no new row survives
remote_count_and_anchoring.observed_top: clear that count without moving focus

deleted_or_unreachable.copy: “{title}” is no longer available. Returned to {destination}.

invalid_suffix_without_title.copy: This path is no longer available. Returned to {destination}.

selected_bit_disappearance.copy: “{title}” is no longer available. Selection cleared.
selected_bit_disappearance.effect: clear only Bit selection/reveal and preserve valid parent path

stale_placement.copy: Placement closed because this Explorer path changed.
stale_placement.effect: close without write under existing placement coordination

destination.meaning: visible title/full label of the exact nearest valid ancestor, or Home
destination.prohibited: sibling, ghost, removed suffix, or abbreviated level
destination.fallback: remove only invalid suffix and retain the longest valid prefix

focus_and_accessibility.ordinary_arrival: remote insertion, count, and status appearance never move focus or selection
focus_and_accessibility.fallback: focus surviving nearest-valid ancestor row when present/focusable, otherwise destination full-label heading
focus_and_accessibility.selected_bit: focus surviving parent row when present, otherwise current parent-column heading
focus_and_accessibility.dismiss: remove only path strip and return focus to surviving fallback ancestor or parent row, otherwise destination column heading
focus_and_accessibility.announcement: announce each newly changed visible path sentence once through one polite atomic status; never announce rerender, viewport anchoring, theme change, or elapsed time

dismissal_and_lifetime.remote_count_clear: its Show new action, authoritative top observation, column close/path change, or Inbox route exit/reload
dismissal_and_lifetime.path_status_clear: Dismiss, next authoritative fallback, explicit user path selection/change, or Inbox route exit/reload
preserved_by: Scratch change while the column remains open
dismissal_and_lifetime.storage: mounted Inbox-page presentation over app-session Explorer path/scroll owners; never durable domain truth

motion.ordinary: all indicator, strip, suffix removal, fallback, anchoring, scroll, and focus changes are immediate
motion.prohibited: fade, slide, scale, spinner, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, and layout-transition animation
motion.reduced_motion: identical geometry, copy, controls, timing, focus, anchoring, and lifetime

theme_mapping.griddo: compact column-label count chip and restrained technical strip using canonical border, muted, primary, text, action, and focus roles
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: Library Index count tab and catalog-paper status slip attached below the destination column label
theme_mapping.neumorphism: named raised count control and shallow inset column notice within the existing column-shadow family
theme_mapping.claymorphism: puffy non-color marker and shape-preserving soft ribbon attached to the destination clay column
theme_mapping.origami: folded count tab and seam-attached paper strip with no ghost fold or repeated motion
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven text count command and static destination-column status record with no fixed JSX color or blink
theme_mapping.retro-mac: hard counter control and in-pane 1-bit system message below the full label with no new window or ghost pane
theme_mapping.graphite: compact editorial index and strengthened-rule column note with restrained monochrome action

implementation_boundary.excludes: path/fallback semantics, stable-ID/offset algorithm, product mutation, placement implementation, VQ-07 search body, product implementation in Task 113, and every Pool/Staging state or realization

exact_release.consumption_condition: Task 113 user checkpoint accepted; its plan marker remains open until then
exact_release.all_other_tasks: unreleased, including Task 114 and the remainder of any later batch
